title: Shared event, version 2
description: One JSON object per line (JSON Lines). Version 2 = version 1 plus project and media ids (an event is unique by project + media + id), evidence (every observation behind the event) and conflict (true when the observations disagree: the top-level fields are the most confident one, all of them stay in evidence). Readers still accept version 1 (no v, or v: 1), which has none of the four; `aethern events merge` upgrades it.

id.description: <type>.<NN>, stable within one media/film, so the same event keeps its id across tools

type.description: dotted name, e.g. blade-contact, footstep, sonic.pick

conf.description: 1 = ground truth from the environment that made the media

project.description: the project, e.g. paper-cinema (aethern.json id, else its name as a slug)

media.description: the media inside the project: film:<name> for a film the engine made, VYRN media ids (v<hash>, t<hash>) for what VYRN ingested

evidence.description: every observation of this event, in the order merged

conflict.description: observations disagree (data.conflict_on names how: type, t, t1, entities)
